survey: The card shows a sports water bottle, tilted to the right and floating against a yellow sunburst background. That is a normal icon pose, not a support fault. Main parts: (1) A blue screw cap sits squarely on the bottle neck. A thin ring shows where the threads meet. (2) A short cylindrical drinking spout with a flat top rises from the centre of the cap. (3) A round carry loop is moulded in one piece with the cap's side and sticks out sideways. Its ring is evenly round and has an open hole. (4) The translucent blue body has a shoulder, a slight waist with a curved grip ridge, and a rounded base. It is drawn in believable perspective. (5) Water inside shows a level line just below the shoulder. The line is consistent with a half-tilted bottle. Every part is connected. Nothing passes through anything else, the counts are right (one cap, one spout, one loop), and nothing is invented.
